leads.name: Downy oak at Vareia near the Theophilos Museum (registry 125)
leads.reason: 3.44 m girth, recorded 15/10/2024, Mytilene municipality. Registry lists land type as private property but access as accessible, with no text explaining; no source says a visitor can reach it without permission, no second source, no height. Hard rule 10: not shipped. Ask the registry or check whether it stands on the museum grounds (Tériade and Theophilos museums are public, Tue-Sun 9-15, per a search summary).
